target.title: chore(autoreview): sync canonical review skill
target.body:
## Summary

- What changed: replaced `.agents/skills/autoreview` with the complete canonical tree from `openclaw/agent-skills@6ab641ada7d94650ca0b644583e56a9af46382b3`.
- Why: align ClawScan with the org default `gpt-5.6-sol` / `high` review configuration, access-only `gpt-5.6-terra` fallback, shared isolation fixes, and canonical drift guidance.

## Scope

- [ ] CLI behavior
- [ ] Scanner adapter
- [ ] Judge/profile/benchmark behavior
- [ ] ClawHub profile proposal at `proposals/<GHSA-ID>/clawscan.yml`
- [ ] Docs only
- [x] Release/CI/repo automation

## Security / Trust Impact

- [ ] No security/trust impact
- [x] Security/trust impact explained

The canonical skill tightens reviewer workspace, environment, secret scanning,
network, and project-configuration isolation. It also adds `AGENTS.md` plus the
required `CLAUDE.md` symlink so future edits start from the updated
`openclaw/agent-skills` source instead of creating a repository-local variant.

## Verification

- [x] `go test -count=1 ./...`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `go run ./cmd/clawscan --help`
- [x] Focused scanner/benchmark/manual proof:
  - autoreview `--self-test`
  - Python runtime tests: 26 passed
  - Python hardening tests: 83 passed, 1 skipped
  - canonical tree byte-for-byte comparison
  - `git diff --check`
  - private-data diff scan
- [ ] For ClawHub profile proposals: I opened the sensitive report through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, and this PR contains only `proposals/<GHSA-ID>/clawscan.yml`
- [ ] For ClawHub profile proposals: I did not edit official bundled profile files under `internal/profiles/`
- [x] Docs site proof (`make docs-site`) or `N/A`: N/A, no docs-site source changed.

## Notes

- Full Go proof was run before the final canonical-only follow-ups: `go test -count=1 ./...` passed, including `cmd/clawscan` (190.069s) and `internal/runner` (165.091s); `go vet ./...` passed. Later canonical revisions touched only `.agents/skills/autoreview`.
- The runtime split review reported one self-test crash, rejected after direct source inspection showed `getattr(args, "fallback_model", None)` and the aggregate self-test passed.
- The policy-test split review intentionally failed closed on secret-scanner regression fixtures; canonical PR #63 already had clean Sol/high review plus Linux and Windows CI.
